description: Logistics strike at distribution hub delayed shipments
resolution: Emergency order placed with SUP-006 (Apex Chlorine Backup). Cost premium 18%. No treatment interruption.
lessons_learned: Maintain minimum 21-day chlorine stock buffer during Q4 logistics peak season.

description: Port congestion delayed coagulant shipment from overseas supplier
resolution: Existing buffer stock was sufficient. No backup order required.
lessons_learned: 30-day buffer stock policy for coagulants is appropriate.

description: Supplier plant maintenance shutdown reduced output by 40%
resolution: Partial order fulfilled by SUP-006. SUP-001 resumed full capacity after maintenance completion.
lessons_learned: Request advance notice of planned maintenance windows from SUP-001 for better planning.
